description: Organization-level dashboard for tenant inventory, the single logical tenant pool, aggregate usage, resource supply, and tenant distribution.

panels.description: Current used tenant bindings in the selected organization's single logical tenant pool.
panels.title: Current Used Tenants

panels.description: Net change over the selected dashboard time range. This is delta() of a gauge, not a creation counter.
panels.title: Net Used Tenant Change

panels.description: Event-driven capacity snapshot. It may be absent after a server restart until a pool admin or replenish operation refreshes it.
panels.title: Free Reserve Slots

panels.description: Share of the configured free-pool reserve currently depleted. Pool size is a reserve target, not a maximum tenant count. This event-driven snapshot may be absent after restart until pool activity refreshes it.
panels.title: Pool Reserve Depletion

panels.description: Total logical storage currently consumed by the selected organization: confirmed bytes plus in-flight reserved bytes.
panels.title: Total Storage Usage

panels.description: Organization storage usage divided by the sum of published positive tenant storage limits.

targets.expr: (sum(max by (tenant_id, state) (drive9_tenant_storage_bytes{tidbcloud_org_id="$org",state=~"confirmed|reserved"})) / sum(max by (tenant_id) (drive9_tenant_storage_bytes{tidbcloud_org_id="$org",state="limit"}))) and (sum(max by (tenant_id) (drive9_tenant_storage_bytes{tidbcloud_org_id="$org",state="limit"})) > 0)

panels.title: Storage Usage Ratio

panels.description: Organization-attributed tenant request rate.
panels.title: Tenant Request Rate

panels.description: Organization-attributed tenant server-error ratio.
panels.title: Tenant 5xx Ratio

panels.description: Organization totals; tenant filtering applies only in the detail rows below.
panels.title: Organization Storage by State

panels.description: Organization request rate grouped by HTTP status class.
panels.title: Organization Request Outcomes

panels.description: Configured reserve target for free tenant slots. This is not a maximum total tenant count. The gauge is refreshed by pool admin/replenish activity and may be absent after restart until then.
panels.title: Reserve Target Size

panels.description: Event-driven physical pool snapshot; it is refreshed with shared-pool observation activity.
panels.title: Active Shared DB Pools

panels.description: Event-driven reserve target and free-slot history. It may have no samples after restart until pool admin or replenish activity refreshes the gauge.
panels.title: Reserve Target and Free Slots

panels.description: 1 - free reserve / configured reserve target, bounded to 0-100%. No data is shown when the target is zero, absent, or has not yet been refreshed after restart.
panels.title: Pool Reserve Depletion Trend

panels.description: Registered role=user pools for the selected organization.
panels.title: Dedicated DB Pools

panels.description: Open connections for selected dedicated tenant DB pools.
panels.title: Dedicated Open Connections

panels.description: Registered shared and shared_schema handles for the selected organization.
panels.title: Shared DB Handles

panels.description: Open shared and shared_schema connections for the selected organization.
panels.title: Shared Open Connections

panels.description: Organization total for role=user connection states. Per-tenant inspection belongs in Tenant Overview.
panels.title: Dedicated DB Connections by State

panels.description: Organization aggregate for dedicated tenant DB waits and closes.
panels.title: Dedicated DB Wait and Close

panels.description: Physical native_shared data-plane handles scoped to the selected organization.
panels.title: Shared Data DB Connections

panels.description: Short-lived shared_schema handles used for bootstrap and contract repair.
panels.title: Shared Schema DB Connections

targets.expr: topk(20, ((sum by (tenant_id) (max by (tenant_id, state) (drive9_tenant_storage_bytes{tidbcloud_org_id="$org",state=~"confirmed|reserved"})) / max by (tenant_id) (drive9_tenant_storage_bytes{tidbcloud_org_id="$org",state="limit"})) and on (tenant_id) (max by (tenant_id) (drive9_tenant_storage_bytes{tidbcloud_org_id="$org",state="limit"}) > 0)))

topk(20, ((max by (tenant_id) (drive9_tenant_media_files{tidbcloud_org_id="$org",state="confirmed"}) / max by (tenant_id) (drive9_tenant_media_files{tidbcloud_org_id="$org",state="limit"})) and on (tenant_id) (max by (tenant_id) (drive9_tenant_media_files{tidbcloud_org_id="$org",state="limit"}) > 0)))

topk(20, ((max by (tenant_id) (drive9_tenant_video_files{tidbcloud_org_id="$org",state="confirmed"}) / max by (tenant_id) (drive9_tenant_video_files{tidbcloud_org_id="$org",state="limit"})) and on (tenant_id) (max by (tenant_id) (drive9_tenant_video_files{tidbcloud_org_id="$org",state="limit"}) > 0)))
